title: Record the reviewer's approval of reward version 2 defaults
summary: The reviewer, James, approved reward version 2's defaults: the stride-mean command-scaled kernel C with its 60-control window and command-change restart, k 0.4, command floors of 0.025 m/s and 0.15 rad/s, the yaw extension of the stationary criterion and the calibrated penalty weights. Each version 2 task definition now records the approval; the style term stays open with the AMP owner.
next: Prepare a version 2 training pack with prepare --mode train --reward-version 2 for the approved Spark run.
reason: Recording an approval changes no reward value, measured result, roadmap marker or gate, and version 1 stays the default.
